test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

She said to me, "Can you look after my baby for a short while?"

options.text: She asked me that if I could look after her baby for a short while.
She asked me if you can look after my baby for a short while.
She asked me if I can look after my baby for a short while.
She asked me if I could look after her baby for a short while.

solution:
The correct answer is **"She asked me if I could look after her baby for a short while."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of an interrogative sentence that starts from the ''helping verb".
 
• Rules to change these types of questions:
 
 
• In these types of questions comma (,") is replaced with the if/whether. 
 
• Said to will get replaced with asked.
 
• The second person 'you' in the direct speech will change to 'I' in the indirect speech.
 
• **'Can'** will get replaced with **'could'. **
 
• **The interrogative sentence** will get converted into **assertive sentence.**
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct sentence:* *__*She asked me if I could look after her baby for a short while.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Direct speech:A direct speech report the precise words a speaker or writer used.
 
• Indirect Speech: Indirect speech focuses more on the content of what someone said rather than their exact words.
 
• **Assertive sentence: **An assertive sentence is a sentence that **states a fact.**
